+## 交互是必须验收的产品能力
+
+最终交付必须是可编辑、可操作、可重算、可比较、可继续实验的应用。静态图、生成图片、单向报告、视频和预计算回放只能辅助教学，不能单独满足功能完成条件。具体操作脚本见 `INTERACTION_ACCEPTANCE.md`。

+四项核心均需形成交互闭环：修改物理条件后求解 Maxwell 场；在三维区域提出扰动并比较伴随预测与实际重算；改变约束并控制优化、回看迭代和继续分支；调整三维制造误差并评价扰动性能。用户须能离开内置示例，创建经过校验的新实验。

The planned NGSolve/Netgen path encountered an application-control rejection of an OpenCascade DLL. No machine security policy was changed. The implemented numerical foundation uses original three-dimensional vector Yee-FDFD and SciPy sparse linear algebra. NGSolve is optional. ## Numerical and data interfaces

Read `docs/CONTRACTS.md` and actual code before implementation. Important interfaces are `ExperimentSpec`, `geometry.build_scene/material_at/epsilon_at`, `solver.make_grid/assemble/solve/probe` and `NativeField`. The internal `MaxwellSystem` exposes the actual sparse matrix, source and material/grid mapping for the discrete adjoint.

Original electric edge values are separate from HDF5 display samples. All consumers preserve complex values, physical coordinates, units, source normalization and run identity. A probe uses original-grid interpolation and is not an exact continuum value. Current-model source amplitudes are not calibrated incident guided-mode powers.

## Commands

The following are agreed CLI forms; successful execution receipts must be inserted before READY:

```powershell
. .\scripts\env.ps1
& '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m lightforge.cli schema
& '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m lightforge.cli solve examples/cavity.json --output .runtime/cavity
& '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m lightforge.cli validate --output .runtime/validation
& '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m lightforge.cli serve --port 4321
```

## Required Stage 2 work

Implement calibrated optical ports/reference normalization, verified three-dimensional adjoint and full parameter-chain derivatives, design/filter/projection mappings, MMA constrained multiwavelength optimization, final independent manufacturing-rule checks, actual three-dimensional fabrication scenarios, robust objectives, held-out evaluation and independent scientific validation. Preserve all four core abilities and meaningful 3D data for the final workbench.

Read every failed/not-run check from the final owner receipt. A current-driven straight-waveguide field or manufactured cavity is not a validated dual-band splitter. Fix scientific limitations and preserve their genuine evidence; do not hide them with labels or visuals.

## Required Stage 3 work

Complete the advanced interactive React/Three.js product, all planned linked spatial/chart views, educational flow, optional AI, experiment lifecycle, integrated scientific and E2E acceptance, portable release, README and competition materials. Video/PDF production remains deferred by the user, with development evidence accumulated for later preparation.
